versions.content: Shift operation When the shift operation is performed, the first or the last bit (depending on the direction of the shift) is filled with "0". Shift left means that the bits are shifted towards the higher values. Shift right means that the bits are shifted towards the lower values. Shift is performed as long as we are in the range defined by [TPS_GST_00008]
